task_scope: Validate bounded parent receipt custody against the persisted supervisor snapshot and refuse replay when a crash leaves the receipt journal ahead of snapshot state.

required_nodes.rationale: A digest-invalid parent receipt chain is rejected without writing a new receipt into its custody.
An append-before-snapshot crash posture is preserved as fail-closed and cannot duplicate receipt sequence.
Valid bounded receipt chains and snapshots reconstruct the existing same-lineage recovery path.
Corrupt snapshots do not permit later receipt publication.
Foreign snapshot and configuration bindings remain denied.

execution_policy: Author only; no execution during construction.
